company.shortDescription: FurtherAI provides AI assistants for insurers, automating workflows like submission intake, policy comparisons, and underwriting processes.
company.description: FurtherAI helps insurers by providing AI-powered assistants tailored for insurance operations. It automates repetitive tasks across workflows such as submission intake, policy comparisons, underwriting audits, claims validations, and form processing. Its system ingests unstructured documents, extracts data, flags inconsistencies, and drives interactions across internal systems or external portals. It maintains isolated data storage per client and enforces enterprise-grade security and compliance controls. Through configurable modules, it adapts to workflows in commercial insurance such as renewals, audits, and binding processes.
